summary: We tackled the challenge of designing a space-mission game that gives students a feel for mission design. Students plan a lunar rover mission and choose its scientific instruments, making tradeoffs between resources and constraints along the way.
details: It is a lunar rover mission design game featuring realistic mission objectives, scientific instruments, and spacecraft and rover options. The game aims to provide a simple, user-friendly experience that gives players an understanding of the trade-offs involved in designing a lunar mission, such as balancing scientific objectives, technical capabilities, mass, power, and budget.
